title: Spread geometric irreducibility of one finite type generic fibre
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a finite type morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\eta$ be a generic point of $T$. Suppose the scheme-theoretic fibre $X_\eta$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible over $\kappa(\eta)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Then there is an open $U\subseteq T$ containing $\eta$ such that $X_t$ is geometrically irreducible over $\kappa(t)$ for every $t\in U$. Geometric irreducibility includes nonemptiness after every field extension.

proof.text: Replace the irreducible base and the source by their reductions. Their reduction maps are universal homeomorphisms, so geometric fibre irreducibility is unchanged. Proposition 29.28.1 gives a nonempty affine base open on which the reduced finite type morphism is flat and of finite presentation. Choose a nonempty affine source open and apply Tag 054X to make its complement nowhere dense in every geometric fibre. It suffices to work with this affine source.

Write the resulting morphism as Spec B to Spec A, with A a domain and B reduced and flat of finite presentation. Its generic fibre is a domain with fraction field L. Choose a finite purely inseparable extension K-prime of the base fraction field K making the reduced compositum separably generated. Scale each generator b with b^q=a/d to db, so (db)^q=a*d^(q-1) lies in A. The subalgebra A-prime generated by these scaled elements is finite integral, radicial, and has fraction field K-prime. Its spectrum is a universal homeomorphism. Base change, reduce, and use Proposition 29.28.1 again to restore flatness and finite presentation.

A separating transcendence basis for L over K and a final algebraic generator yield an absolutely irreducible hypersurface with the same function field. Clear denominators to spread a common affine open. Tag 054X makes that open dense in the fibres on both sides after shrinking. For Tag 0557, change variables by separated powers to make the defining polynomial monic after inverting a nonzero coefficient. For each possible pair of positive monic factor degrees, use a finite type coefficient algebra to represent factorizations, bounding degrees in the other variables by the polynomial degrees. Absolute irreducibility and Nullstellensatz make each coefficient algebra zero at the algebraically closed generic fibre. Each is killed after inverting a nonzero base element; invert their product to exclude every field-valued factorization. Thus all hypersurface fibres are geometrically irreducible.

Transfer irreducibility through the common fibrewise dense open. Shrink to the open image of the flat finitely presented morphism so fibres remain nonempty. Descend the open through the universal homeomorphisms. A nonempty open of an irreducible space contains its generic point, giving the claimed neighbourhood.
